newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks end mixed, volume again low.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks end mixed, volume again low.

text.p: The Ghana stock exchange ended mixed on Friday after another slow session, dealers said.
Most shares were unchanged from the previous session on Wednesday and the GSE All-Share Index slipped 1.15 points to 385.09.
Volume was a meagre 60,150 shares, well down from Wednesday's 206,440.
Among the few shares that moved, Ghana Commercial Bank fell 20 cedis to 620, while Pioneer Tobacco rose 15 cedis to 275.
